text: A Spooky Trick with Real Ghosts?!
You cleared Jacky's spooky trick!\nGo to the next area where Jeila's trick awaits!
Jeila released her witch hands as her secret trick.\nMove forward while dodging the fierce attacks and beat them!
You beat Jeila's witch hands. Now only the trick\ncreated by Pelulu, Olant, and Potumkin is left.\nLet's move on to clear it!
Fight and pacify Sibylares, the shaman ghost that appeared\nfrom the mausoleum that Pelulu destroyed!
[[N]]Defeat the witch hands in Phasma Forest: Area 2
